name: Four Seasons Hotel Houston
positioning: A 30 storey urban resort in the centre of downtown Houston, with Pan-Latin dining, a speakeasy bar and a rooftop pool
best_for: Travelers who want an urban resort in downtown Houston
Guests who enjoy bars and bourbon, with Topgolf Swing Suites on site

facts.text: The hotel is at 1300 Lamar Street, Houston, Texas.
The hotel is a 30 storey urban resort in the centre of downtown Houston.
The hotel is located within 200 metres of Discovery Green Park.
The hotel is located within 300 metres of Green Street.
Bayou & Bottle is a bourbon and whiskey bar offering more than 200 whiskies.
Bandista is an intimate speakeasy and cocktail bar.

highlights.text: The hotel has a rooftop pool oasis.
Topgolf Swing Suites are located within Bayou & Bottle on the first floor of the hotel.
Bandista is an intimate modern-day speakeasy, literally hidden behind a bookcase.
Bandista is recognized as the #47 bar in North America by 50 Best Bars.
The hotel describes its rooms and suites as newly renovated.

considerations.text: The spa has 3 treatment rooms, plus a Couple's Suite.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
